scope: Two-source matched-training diagnostic after frozen-policy probes; not a final experiment or independent generalization test
selection_rationale: Development positive control (Horse) and a full-horizon but inaccurate kick (Side); chosen after prior diagnostic results and not claimed outcome-independent
primary_endpoint: Every-frame strict pass on untouched raw reference under randomized evaluation; all cross-reference and nominal results also reported
initialization: Both arms trained from random; actor/critic and normalizer initial tensor digests must match before second arm learns
forbidden: selecting data by new execution results
completion_followup: Aggregate all four training receipts and sixteen evaluations, compare per-motion initial digests and exposure, archive reports, then stop
